components.css: .ds-detail{font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;background:white;color:var(--ink,#152a36);border:1px solid var(--line,#dbe2e6);border-radius:12px;padding:23px}.ds-detail h2{font-size:19px;line-height:1.3;margin:0 0 8px}.ds-detail blockquote{margin:16px 0;padding-left:12px;border-left:1px solid #9bb9c3}.ds-detail p{font-size:12px;line-height:1.55;color:#304e5c;margin:0 0 7px}.ds-detail cite{font-style:normal;font-size:10px;color:var(--muted,#526773)}.ds-detail summary{cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:#294e5d;padding:14px 0;line-height:1.5;border-top:1px solid var(--line,#dbe2e6)}.ds-detail summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #168a9c;outline-offset:4px}.ds-detail pre{white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;font-size:11px;line-height:1.6;background:#f2f6f7;padding:15px;border-radius:6px;max-height:440px;overflow:auto}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}

narrative.overview: A dense sales workbench with a navy navigation rail, teal action buttons, compact review queue and bordered evidence detail. The shipped flow separates candidate signals, investigation findings and explicit task approval.
keyCharacteristics: Navy rail and cool neutral surfaces
dos: Do pair state colors with explicit labels.
Do preserve supporting evidence and approval controls.
Do retain visible focus and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Do not present candidate signals as established risk.
Do not create tasks without the separate confirmation step.
Do not obscure error details or scripted-demo labels.
